verdict.rationale: Cactus is an on-device model, inference and fine-tuning platform, so a built-in assistant that takes tasks inside its dashboard or CLI is a fair axis, but the evidence shows none. The pack only says users can drive the platform from their own external coding agent with an API key, which is a user-side workaround. The browser demo and the Android chat app showcase the models themselves rather than an assistant that carries out tasks within the product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
